item.title: Last Week In Code E006
item.description: Its E006. YAY. It has been a week and a half. I spent most of it doing archival work. The last part of the week I sunk into setting up mediawiki. I did some interview prep type questions also and I uploaded some of the solutions. But that wasn't as serious as the archival tasks. I am preparing to change locations. I am not so sure about my new location's internet efficiency or its affordability.
